query:
INSERT INTO
  flailed (message, ordinal, job, run)
SELECT
  ?1,
  ?2,
  (
    SELECT
      runs.job
    FROM
      runs
    WHERE
      runs.id = ?3
  ),
  ?3
WHERE
  NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT
      1
    FROM
      structured
    WHERE
      structured.message = ?1
      AND structured.ordinal = ?2
  )
